rows.note: Use this for bending the body as a respectful gesture, and it is the all-purpose choice for that meaning.

example.english: We bow and greet the principal when we see him.
example.traditional: 我哋見到校長，就鞠躬問好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gin3 dou2 haau6 zoeng2 zau6 guk1 gung1 man6 hou2

rows.note: Use this for the front end of a boat or ship, not for a person sitting there.

example.english: The bow of our boat hit the floating platform.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zek3 syun4 tau4 zong6 dou3 fau4 toi4

rows.note: Use this for something physically bending or curving, especially when it sags downward under weight.

example.english: This shelf will bow downward with so much stuff on it.
example.traditional: 呢個層架擺得太多嘢，會向下彎。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cang4 gaa3 baai2 dak1 taai3 do1 je5 wui5 hoeng3 haa6 waan1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the weapon used to shoot arrows.

example.english: This bow is tightly strung, so it must shoot arrows accurately.
example.traditional: 呢把弓拉得好實，射箭一定好準。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 gung1 laai1 dak1 hou2 sat6 se6 zin3 jat1 ding6 hou2 zeon2

rows.note: Use this for a formal bowing gesture showing respect, especially in ceremonial contexts.

example.english: At the ceremony, everyone made a formal bow together.
example.traditional: 喺典禮上，大家一齊行鞠躬禮。
example.jyutping: hai2 din2 lai5 soeng6 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 haang4 guk1 gung1 lai5
